correctness.rationale: For smooth curves the cited source gives \(\deg\operatorname{Tan}(C)=2D+2g-2\) and \(\deg\operatorname{Sec}(C)=\binom{D-1}{2}-g\). Standard complete-intersection adjunction gives \(2g-2=D(S-N-1)\), yielding the two displayed formulas. The comparison reduces exactly to \(\prod_i(y_i+1)\le3\sum_i y_i+1\) for \(y_i=d_i-1\ge1\); monotonicity proves no solutions for at least four factors and reduces three factors to the three listed cases. Exact integer replay over 75,504 tuples agrees.
